summary: Cancelled sales order S00021. Clicking "Cancel" opened Odoo's "Cancel Sales Order" wizard; a leftover "Edit: fwod106-dg-n1 Bench Customer" dialog was stacked on top and blocked clicks, so I closed it (X / btn-close, no changes saved) and then pressed the wizard's "Cancel" (cancel without email) button. The statusbar immediately switched to "Cancelled" [checked], and after a full page reload of the record URL the status radio still reads "Cancelled" (Sales Order / Quotation Sent / Quotation disabled) with a "Set to Quotation" button now offered — so the order is no longer active. Observed status: Cancelled.
